text: Sell RGTI — revenue is shrinking by 34%, the stock is down 45% with insiders selling and nearly 18% short interest, meaning other investors are actively betting against it, so cut your losses here.

Sell QBTS — it's down 41% with no profits, heavy insider selling, and over 21% short interest (meaning one in five available shares is being bet against), so this position is broken and should be closed.
Trim IONQ — it's down 25% and 55% off its high with no earnings to support the price, so reduce your exposure to limit further losses while quantum computing remains all promise and no profit.
Raise your MSTR stop-loss from $96.67 to $102.01 — this locks in more downside protection on a volatile leveraged Bitcoin play that could turn against you quickly.

Add to MU — Micron's 49% revenue growth and PE of just 6.3 (meaning you're paying very little relative to earnings) with a streak of beating expectations makes it one of the strongest fundamental stories in your portfolio.
Add to UNH — UnitedHealth is a proven healthcare giant trading at a fair PE of 17 with nearly 12% revenue growth and strong cash generation, making it a quality defensive anchor.

Add to ADBE — Adobe's PE of just 9 with 10% revenue growth and outstanding free cash flow yield (cash it generates relative to its price) suggests the market is undervaluing this profitable software leader.
Add to GOOGL — Google's 15% revenue growth at a PE of 22 with strong free cash flow makes it a quality compounder trading at a reasonable price in an uncertain market.
